title: Iterating-operations-loop (cross-regime composing morphism; controller at stable-aperiodic-articulation-cell)
description: Regime at controller level: stable-aperiodic-articulation-cell (platform-level loop orchestrator). Body composes morphisms across all four regimes — the unique place where today's four-regime grammar shows up most concretely. Per-stage regime decomposition: (1) heartbeat-selection — stable-aperiodic-articulation-cell at platform scope (selects which entity ticks next); (2) dispatch — scott-continuous-posit-category (positing-regime; twist-product fusion is Scott-continuous); (3) mode-application — transfinite-predication-category (predicating-regime fiber restriction); (4) tick/settlement — finite-settlement-algebra (settling-regime, κ < ω; one closure-rule application); (5) cost-tracking and audit — finite-settlement-algebra (Lawvere-quantale cost composition; witness emission). Each emitted witness row carries a regime tag so the cross-regime composition is auditable. Variance: restriction (advances the operations-loop state through one cycle).
